acceptance_test_interpretation: PCFL-CPU-01 is the structural identifiability gate: every registered root must replay exactly and certify zero single-record closure, different A/B paths, necessary bridges and bindings, a genuinely separating public experiment, and delayed dependence on both old and new evidence. Its shortcut probes must include target-only, state-only, identifier, position, template, action-frequency, answer-frequency, path-length, and pretrained semantic-prior probes. It should additionally require paired twins to have identical actor-visible byte histories until the registered separating action; otherwise it does not fully establish paired-world indistinguishability. PCFL-CPU-02 is the role-boundary gate. I interpret its private-field noninterference condition as holding phase-legal public inputs fixed: changing a hidden seed, root label, future goal, oracle annotation, or intervention label must not affect the corresponding actor view before a public causal consequence is released. It cannot mean that public outcomes remain invariant after actions whose purpose is to distinguish roots. The receipt must cover argv, environment, filenames, errors, timing channels, caches, sessions, and direct object access, not prompt bytes alone. PCFL-CPU-03 must enforce the complete causal chronology: old public action precedes outcome; DREAM proposal precedes independent support; supported compilation precedes old checkpoint; A/B probes are isolated; the exact GOALS_COMPLETE projection precedes missing-relation declaration; experiment selection precedes dispatch; dispatch precedes public outcome; outcome precedes grounded row; commit precedes reset; and the delayed goal is unavailable before reset. Illegal or reordered histories must leave all state unchanged. PCFL-CPU-04 is necessary for carrier attribution. Authentic links, atoms-only, truthful-null, and deranged carriers must be compiled from the identical admitted public ledger and matched under a ratified exposure vector. Derangement must preserve nonsemantic topology, degree, ordering, answer marginals, type counts, lengths, reader behavior, and resource envelope while destroying every claim-critical binding. Cuts, redirections, and shams must be target-closed and must not create collateral retrieval or formatting changes. PCFL-CPU-05 correctly fixes the M independent unit as a registered environment root. The reducer must reject duplicated, nested, reordered, selectively missing, or cross-root receipts and retain prespecified adverse values. Paths, goals, interventions, calls, branches, checkpoints, model samples, and adapter seeds remain repeated measures. LINEAGE-01 tests the scoped clean-source boundary rather than semantic target blindness. It must reject unknown, path-only, DONE-only, forged, aliased, symlinked, quarantined, or descendant-derived inputs before protected exposure, and must demonstrate no permitted descendant return to source or parent. Passing does not prove absence of human, administrator, provider, or semantic laundering channels. LINEAGE-02 tests only root-local transactional persistence: checkpoint, corpus, compiler/writer receipt, memory state, and manifest advance together or not at all; exactly one concurrent expected-head commit wins; and recovery exposes the complete old or new state. It must not be interpreted as clean-source promotion. M-TEXT-01 is the first behavioral instrument gate. Using the same finite reader and phase machine intended for transport, authentic linked text must show preregistered root-level advantages over atoms-only, truthful-null, deranged connectivity, bridge removal, twin redirection, uncertainty sham, REACHOUT_OFF, old-cut, and no-write conditions while retaining atomic facts. This can establish text-solvability, goal-specific composition, action improvement, information-seeking choice, and delayed old-plus-new use for the registered roots. It does not by itself establish DREAM authorship, LoRA transport, online flywheel learning, continued improvement, or superiority to raw context, RAG, native graph, and strong memory baselines. E0-PREREQ-01 is correctly independent and noncompensatory. It must establish native response-only training, provenance-complete inputs, interface preservation, atomic rollback, and wrong-life/binding sensitivity. Text success cannot substitute for writer validity. M-LORA-01 can support only a bounded transport attribution after M-TEXT-01 and E0 pass. The LoRA and text arms must contain the same canonical semantic rows, while adapter-off, wrong-root, new-binding swap, no-write/sham-write, and read-mask controls rule out prompt ritual, generic finetuning, and leakage. Same semantics is not the same as fixed memory: full adapter, decoder, index, prompt, and auxiliary-state bytes and work must be reported, and no physical compression or LoRA-efficiency claim follows. L-BASELINE-01 is only a prerequisite and plumbing test. It certifies that ACTIVE_TEXT_FIXED actually writes, retrieves, and uses memory, has task headroom, has a prospectively defined local-plateau candidate, and receives the same exogenous opportunity tape as F. It does not test that F has a positive late slope, exceeds B's slope, retains old competence, or wins at the terminal cut; therefore it cannot by itself support CLM-L or continued-improvement language. C-CODEC-01 supports a separate semantic-code rate--distortion result if all three representations decode to the identical canonical public ledger, all retained representation/decoder/index/prompt bytes and work are charged, generator/oracle access is unavailable or charged, false decoded relations and model-produced false memories are separated, and uncertainty is clustered by disjoint root. Increasing loads are repeated measures, not independent samples. LoRA remains transport until a measured complete-state physical-byte crossover. Across the suite, memory transport is evidenced only by M-LORA-01 after text and E0; composition is evidenced by goal-specific constructive paths and bridge/twin/derangement dependence in M-TEXT-01; action improvement is evidenced by registered root-level return or success contrasts; online learning is not established because L uses an exogenous stream and M contains only a bounded within-root write relay; and continued improvement is not established without a separate L end-to-end acceptance test covering the ordered plateau, slope, retention, terminal-margin, and uncertainty gates.

ambiguities.impact: Without an exact prefix-collision and balance law, names, ordering, answer frequency, path length, or template identity can reveal the root or target before experiential evidence is used.
ambiguities.question: What exact actor-visible byte prefix must be identical across each counterfactual pair, when may ordinary public outcomes first diverge, and what balancing law covers actions, answers, lengths, symbols, templates, and presentation order?

ambiguities.impact: Read literally, PCFL-CPU-02 would forbid legitimate public outcome differences caused by different hidden roots; read weakly, it might miss seed or intervention leakage.
ambiguities.question: Is private-byte noninterference defined counterfactually while holding the current phase-legal public history fixed, with divergence permitted only after a registered public action causes an ordinary observable outcome?

ambiguities.impact: If an oracle or deterministic generator authors authentic links, M tests use of supplied annotations rather than DREAM constructing grounded connections from experience.
ambiguities.question: Who authors authentic links, what finite relation algebra and grounding rule are used, and is deterministic compilation limited to normalization of child-produced, public-evidence-supported proposals?

ambiguities.impact: Returning too much from A/B probes can leak scores or answers into experiment selection; returning nothing prevents prior traversal from informing gap identification.
ambiguities.question: What exact canonical public bytes join the isolated A/B probes at GOALS_COMPLETE, and do they include only goals, child actions/declarations, and ordinary public outcomes while excluding oracle paths, correctness, scores, and critiques?

ambiguities.impact: Unspecified persistence can let context, caches, indexes, RNG state, or sibling outcomes carry the answer across probes, reset, or write conditions.
ambiguities.question: Which actor context, workspace, memory rows, adapter, index, cache, RNG, controller state, and public ledger fields survive the old checkpoint, A/B forks, DREAM, SLEEP, no-write/sham-write operations, and delayed reset?

ambiguities.impact: Without a nonadaptive or recurrence-disabled arm, success may be answer-prior execution or one-shot retrieval rather than goal-conditioned path construction.
ambiguities.question: What recurrence-removal condition commits all reads before seeing returns, and what registered margin must separate it from the recurrent thinker using identical atomic evidence and budgets?

ambiguities.impact: The experiment cannot determine whether Dream-memory-Think is useful relative to raw context, episodic RAG, a native explicit graph, organized active text, or a standard no-lifetime agent.
ambiguities.question: Which no-memory, honest raw-context, raw episodic RAG, native graph, ACTIVE_TEXT_FIXED, and answer-prior controls are required for M, and which comparisons are mechanism diagnostics versus superiority claims?

ambiguities.impact: One old checkpoint plus one new write tests a single relay but not cumulative local edge growth over repeated dreams or increasing lifetime.
ambiguities.question: How many independently supported dream/compile cuts must accumulate within one descendant life, which cross-cut composition targets are required, and what cadence-removal, shuffled-connectivity, scale, and lifetime-length ablations test that accumulation?

ambiguities.impact: Allowing memory to accumulate across independent M roots or L lineages would violate root independence and clean-descendant isolation; forbidding it means the requested multi-life accumulation must be interpreted statistically rather than as one organism's memory.
ambiguities.question: Does 'multiple lives' mean multiple episodes and DREAM cuts inside one registered descendant lifetime, or memory transfer across independent roots/lineages? The latter is incompatible with the proposed unit and no-return rules unless separately designed.

ambiguities.impact: Carrier differences in bytes, rows, tokens, retrieval candidates, topology, compute, or padding can masquerade as semantic binding effects.
ambiguities.question: What is the registered exposure vector for text and LoRA carriers, what nonsemantic padding is allowed, and how is the padding/sham itself shown behaviorally inert?

ambiguities.impact: Same-semantic text and LoRA arms do not answer a fixed-memory comparison, while equal physical bytes generally require different semantic coverage.
ambiguities.question: Will text-versus-LoRA results be reported only as same-semantics transport, or will a separate budget sweep compare utility at fixed complete charged bytes and work without implying equal substrates?

ambiguities.impact: A special cue, unique action form, cheaper action, or distinctive outcome alphabet could select the intended experiment without uncertainty-guided reasoning.
ambiguities.question: What are the canonical authentic uncertainty object, truthful sham, candidate experiment set, costs, outcome alphabet, tied separating set, and separate scores for experiment choice and realized information?

ambiguities.impact: Statements that a condition 'clears' gates are not executable without root count, margins, failure values, hierarchy, and uncertainty rules; conditional passage can also hide failed cells.
ambiguities.question: What are M's root universe, DEV and confirmation split laws, effect margins, noncompensatory reducer, uncertainty method, multiplicity rule, stopping rule, and disposition of failed or unrun gated cells?

ambiguities.impact: The current acceptance suite certifies only the comparator and tape plumbing, leaving lifetime length, late slopes, retention, and terminal superiority untested.
ambiguities.question: What separate L acceptance test binds independent lineage count, cuts, plateau-equivalence margin, F late-slope margin, F-minus-B slope margin, retention floor, terminal practical margin, covariance, failures, multiplicity, and resource policy?

ambiguities.impact: A small deterministic generator, shared schema, or free decoder can create apparent compression; within-root loads alone do not establish general scaling.
ambiguities.question: Which disjoint roots and ordered loads are used, which generator/schema/decoder/index costs are charged standalone or amortized, and what post-crossover points would be required for any physical compression claim?

ambiguities.impact: Preregistration without an independent release principal does not prevent score-correlated timing, retry, stopping, or investigator feedback.
ambiguities.question: Is confirmation merely hash-bound and preregistered, or strictly human-blinded; if blinded, what separate scheduler, result store, release authority, retry codes, and administrative boundary enforce it?

assumptions: All listed source hashes and the architecture-change hash identify the exact bytes supplied for this interpretation.
No root, target, carrier, split, or threshold is selected using model performance or partial scientific results; systematic certificate failures invalidate the registered generator version.
M and C use one fixed parent-deleted child snapshot read-only across roots, with root-local memories, sessions, caches, RNG namespaces, and journals isolated from every other root.
L lineages are independently raised units; F and B branches share only the prebound birth and exogenous opportunity tape and cannot observe or affect one another after forking.
Memory may accumulate across episodes and repeated DREAM/SLEEP cuts inside a registered descendant life, but never across independent M roots, C roots, L lineages, or terminal descendants.
Authentic links and transition rows are derived only from phase-admitted public evidence; hidden oracle truth may certify or score them but does not author model-visible semantic content.

Future goals, target annotations, intervention assignments, certificates, and terminal scores cannot influence earlier source experience, DREAM proposals, carrier construction, retrieval ranking, or write admission.

The explicit-text and LoRA transport arms use the same canonical admitted semantic row identities; differences in physical representation, capacity, bytes, and work remain measured rather than assumed equal.
Deranged connectivity is a fixed-point-free, topology- and exposure-preserving perturbation that removes all claim-critical correct bindings without changing unrelated facts.

A valid constructive path requires dependencies on newly retrieved or newly observed public values; a correct action or answer without that dependency is behavioral success but not composition credit.

The L opportunity tape contains genuinely new information at later cuts, is outcome-independent, and is immutable before either branch runs; adaptive evaluation probes cannot change its later contents.
C decoders receive only their charged representation and declared shared schema, never a compact root seed, hidden generator, oracle graph, or uncharged candidate catalog.
ACTIVE_TEXT_FIXED must be tested as an executable evolving-memory agent with a frozen acting model, not represented by a prompt sketch or static text dump.

Passing CPU gates demonstrates software invariants only; passing text M demonstrates instrument solvability only; neither authorizes model training, GPU execution, confirmation, or a scientific claim.
claim_delta_interpretation: The claim ladder is appropriately noncompensatory but the evidence surfaces are uneven. CLM-CPU-CORE is supportable only as deterministic software, visibility, intervention, reducer, and root-local isolation behavior. CLM-LINEAGE is supportable only as a scoped OS/process-authority and tamper-evidence statement with explicit provider, administrator, human-memory, and semantic-disjointness limits. CLM-M can become a bounded fixed-child, registered-root mechanism-relay claim if authentic versus null/deranged linkage, different-goal paths, bridge/twin necessity, uncertainty-guided separating action, grounded write, delayed old-plus-new necessity, text solvability, E0, and LoRA attribution all pass. Even then it does not show that LoRA contains a literal graph, that DREAM rather than an oracle authored the links unless authorship is bound, that the whole organism beats raw context/RAG/native graph, that learning is on-policy or self-improving, or that results generalize across children. CLM-L describes the right ordered evidentiary standard—certified comparator plateau, positive F late slope, positive paired slope advantage, retention, terminal margin, and uncertainty—but no acceptance test currently executes those gates, so the proposed acceptance suite cannot release CLM-L. CLM-C is correctly limited to text-interface semantic-code rate--distortion unless complete charged LoRA state crosses the measured physical threshold. Same-semantic LoRA performance is transport, not compression or fixed-memory superiority. The proposal should keep memory transport, compositional use, action improvement, online learning, and continued improvement as distinct claims: M-LORA addresses transport; M path and intervention receipts address composition; root-level action returns address action improvement; neither M nor exogenous L establishes an on-policy action-experience flywheel; and only a completed L confirmation can address continued improvement over one registered comparator and finite horizon.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add an explicit invariant that every paired root has byte-identical actor-visible histories, action catalogs, costs, lengths, and non-target marginals until the registered separating action, followed only by the ordinary public divergence caused by that action. Apply target-only and presentation-prior probes to the full frozen root suite.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: PCFL-CPU-01 names shortcut probes but its expected result does not explicitly require prefix byte collision or balanced target priors. PCFL-CPU-02, read literally, is overbroad because legitimate public outcomes must sometimes differ after separating actions.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The stated CPU acceptance language does not yet fully force paired-world indistinguishability or exclude target-only and presentation shortcuts.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Bind one target-independent DREAM/link producer that sees only admitted public evidence and emits one-edge proposals with later independent support. Restrict deterministic SLEEP compilation to validation, canonicalization, and rendering; if oracle-authored links are retained, narrow the claim to use of supplied linked memory.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The graph permits either DREAM/local proposals or deterministic compilation. An oracle or hand-coded compiler could insert the useful structure, letting THINK pass without the organism having connected its own experience.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal cannot attribute connected experiential knowledge to DREAM while authentic-link authorship remains unresolved.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Include a recurrence-disabled fixed-query arm using the same atoms and budgets, plus registered no-memory/answer-prior, honest raw-context, episodic RAG, native explicit-graph, and organized-memory controls. Report these as distinct composition, protocol, and comparative-utility contrasts.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Bridge, twin, and derangement ablations show dependence on assigned semantics, but they do not show that recurrent goal-conditioned construction is necessary or that raw context, RAG, an explicit graph, or a standard agent cannot bypass Dream-memory-Think.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: M-TEXT-01 is insufficient to establish usefulness of the complete dream-memory-think path relative to major bypass architectures because recurrence removal and several bypass baselines are absent.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require at least three within-life DREAM/SLEEP cuts with increasing unique relation coverage, old-only/new-only/cross-era targets, a cadence or recurrence-removal arm, topology-preserving shuffled connectivity, and registered relation-count/path-depth/lifetime-length sweeps. Keep independent roots and lineages isolated.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: M currently demonstrates one old-plus-one-new relay. L has repeated cuts but no edge-level accumulation acceptance test, while C scale concerns representation loads rather than developmental memory. None forces local dream edges to accumulate over repeated cycles and then be composed only when a later goal demands them.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The current acceptance suite does not test recurrent accumulation of local dream edges across an increasing lifetime or benchmark scale beyond a single relay.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add a separate L end-to-end acceptance test whose evidence artifact contains independent paired-lineage receipts and mechanically enforces the ordered headroom, B plateau-equivalence, F positive late slope, positive F-minus-B slope advantage, retention, terminal-margin, failure, and uncertainty gates.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: L-BASELINE-01 certifies the comparator and opportunity-tape plumbing only. It supplies no outcome requirement for the full learner's longitudinal behavior.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: CLM-L is not supported by any current acceptance test, despite being a headline-eligible claim delta.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Describe M text-versus-LoRA strictly as a same-semantics transport comparison. If fixed-memory utility is desired, add a separate complete-byte and work budget sweep in which all payload, adapter, decoder, index, prompt, and auxiliary state is charged, and report the resulting rate--utility frontier without assuming equal semantic coverage.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Equal canonical rows control meaning, not memory capacity. Text and LoRA have materially different fixed costs and interfaces, so neither M-LORA-01 nor C-CODEC-01 presently establishes a fixed-memory advantage across substrates.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal does not implement the requested fixed-memory comparison across text and LoRA substrates and must not imply that same semantics or matched exposure equals fixed memory.

disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep the bounded M acquisition/write relay, L exogenous lifetime comparison, and any future on-policy flywheel as separate estimands. Reserve online self-improvement or memory-improved evidence-acquisition language for a separately ratified design where memory changes actions, those actions change acquired public evidence, the evidence enters later supported DREAM/SLEEP cycles, and later action improves under appropriate controls.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: M can show one information-seeking action followed by a grounded write and delayed benefit, while L deliberately prevents adaptive probes from changing future opportunity content. These are valuable but do not establish an ongoing action-experience flywheel.
disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposed evidence can separate transport, composition, and bounded action improvement, but it cannot support online-learning or continued-flywheel language as currently tested.

graph_delta_interpretation: The graph reconstructs a controlled organism inside a one-way experimental shell. An authenticated immutable source and exact plan feed a role-separated supervisor. The trusted controller alone owns sealed root, seed, schedule, oracle, and intervention data; it releases canonical public views to the recurrent actor and phase-admitted public evidence to the carrier compiler. Public action outcomes and supported local connections enter a root-local transactional journal. M reduces terminal environment roots, L reduces independently raised F/B lineage pairs, and C reduces disjoint roots with within-root loads. Explicit text must establish the semantic relay before the independent E0 writer gate permits any LoRA transport interpretation. ACTIVE_TEXT_FIXED is a required evolving comparator for L. Every descendant is terminal relative to the source. This topology prevents a receipt, path, probe, checkpoint, or adapter seed from becoming an independent unit, but it does not itself force the complete organism to be useful. Usefulness requires the generator and intervention graph to make target answers unavailable from goal/state priors, one record, raw context, or an unstructured reader; to make different goals require different supported paths; and to make decisive actions change under bridge, binding, recurrence, write, and root interventions. The graph also correctly forbids memory accumulation across independent lives: accumulation belongs inside a registered descendant life, while roots and lineages provide replication.

loop_delta_interpretation: THINK_WAKE is a recurrent, goal-conditioned action loop: the actor receives the current public goal/state, one bounded local read at a time, and ordinary public outcomes; it updates or backtracks before issuing the next action. DREAM_LOCAL_GROWTH is offline and target-independent: it may propose only local relations from eligible replay, and proposal multiplicity is not evidence. SLEEP_LOCAL_CONSOLIDATION admits only chronologically supported public semantic rows and atomically advances root-local state; it must not expose a future goal or convert a provisional proposal into truth. These loops describe the intended organism only if their temporal order is mechanically enforced. Old experience must occur before proposals, independent prediction evidence must follow proposals, A/B goal probes must fork from a common old checkpoint, the joined public probe record must precede experiment selection, the separating action must precede its outcome, the grounded row must follow that outcome, SLEEP commit must precede a true reset, and the delayed goal must appear only afterward. Multiple local edges may accumulate over repeated DREAM/SLEEP cuts within one registered descendant life, while THINK should assemble a goal-specific path only at use time. The current M loop tests one old-plus-new relay rather than repeated accumulation. L deliberately separates learning from adaptive probing by giving F and B the same exogenous opportunity tape; it can test longitudinal use but not an on-policy flywheel. C is a representation loop, not a learning loop. Recurrence removal, shuffled connectivity, topology/load scale, and lifetime-length interventions need explicit measurement surfaces rather than being inferred from the existence of these loops.
system_thesis_interpretation: The intended organism is not a LoRA, graph, dreamer, or planner in isolation. Ordinary actions produce public outcomes; DREAM searches locally over eligible replay for target-independent candidate relations; later independent public prediction evidence determines support; SLEEP canonicalizes and transactionally stores only supported transitions; a LoRA, if used after E0, transports those already grounded semantics; and recurrent THINK retrieves one local item at a time, constructs a path conditioned on the current goal, acts, observes, and revises. Within a registered descendant lifetime, later outcomes may feed later dream and sleep cycles, allowing a sparse local field to accumulate while paths are materialized only when demanded by a goal. M is a fixed-child root-level mechanism assay, L is an independent paired-lineage longitudinal assay against one certified evolving text-memory agent, and C is a disjoint-root semantic-code assay. The game forces this organism to be useful only if counterfactual worlds are indistinguishable before experiential separation, target answers and action priors are balanced, no single record closes a goal, authentic local connectivity and recurrent composition change actions under matched interventions, and delayed success requires both earlier and newly acquired grounded evidence. Cross-root memory accumulation would contradict the design; roots and lineages replicate evidence, while accumulation occurs only inside a declared life.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix has the right semantic partition: intake and controller may know source, root, seed, schedule, oracle, and intervention identities; the actor receives only the current phase-legal public goal/state, bounded history projection, legal actions, and memory returns; the compiler receives only eligible public evidence and supported semantics; the journal owns local transactional state; and the reducer receives terminal audit receipts. For benchmark validity, this must be enforced at the complete byte and capability level, including argv, environment, filenames, working directories, logs, errors, timing, caches, provider sessions, RNG services, shared stores, and inherited descriptors. Paired roots require a stronger temporal reading than static forbidden fields: actor-visible bytes must collide until an ordinary separating action produces a public outcome, after which that outcome may legitimately differ. Future goals, sibling probes, intervention labels, oracle paths, correctness, and scores must remain hidden throughout carrier creation and acting. The compiler must not use the current or future target to choose links, rows, retrieval keys, padding, or ordering. L must reveal only the next common exogenous opportunity and isolate opposite-arm state; C must give every codec the same canonical public ledger and no hidden generator or oracle. Terminal results may reach only the reducer/report sink and cannot alter later registered units or the source. The clean-lineage rows establish a scoped enforced no-return boundary, not semantic target blindness, provider statelessness, administrator exclusion, or erasure of human knowledge.
